name: orion-ai
description: Autonomous AI software engineer: plans with todo lists, edits code, runs tests and terminal commands with your approval, verifies its own work, and reports honestly — in your language.

orion.backendPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Orion `backend` folder (the one containing `app/main.py`). Leave empty to auto-detect it from the opened workspace. See the [setup guide](https://github.com/grenitho/orion/blob/main/docs/PANDUAN_SETUP.md).

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Orion
walkthroughs.description: One-time setup: install the local backend, add a free API key, and run your first task.

steps.title: Install the backend (one time)
steps.description:
Orion's brain is a small Python server that runs on your own computer — your code and keys never leave your machine.
Easiest: run the built-in wizard — it installs everything for you, no terminal needed.
[Run Setup Wizard](command:orion.openSetupWizard)
Prefer a terminal? On Windows, one PowerShell line does the same job: [Open Setup Guide](command:orion.openSetupGuide)

steps.title: Start the backend
steps.description:
Orion starts its backend automatically when VS Code opens.
If the chat ever says it cannot reach the backend, start it by hand:
[Start Backend](command:orion.startBackend)

steps.title: Send your first task
steps.description:
Open the chat and describe what you want, in your own language. For example:
*"Add a dark-mode toggle, test it, and update the README."*
Risky terminal commands always ask for your approval first.
[Open Chat Panel](command:orion.openChat)

steps.title: Optional: more keys, smarter models
steps.description:
Rotate several free Gemini keys, or plug in models from OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen and more via `backend/.env` — no code changes needed.
[Multi-provider guide](https://github.com/grenitho/orion/blob/main/docs/PANDUAN_SETUP.md)

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
